concerns.text: T004 implements 'selecting a single primary control group per treatment arm' while spec FR-008 and US1 AC mandate 'splitting control groups proportionally'. The plan documents this as an override, but the spec was never amended, so the task silently weakens a stated FR. Either update spec FR-008/US1 to record the change or restore the specified behavior.

FR-003 requires regex-pattern extraction of intervention components; T004's requirements list omits any component-extraction method (the plan's keyword/confidence-score pipeline 'overrides FR-003' without a spec amendment). The task neither implements the FR nor carries the documented replacement.

Principle VI requires logging 'search query strings and retrieval timestamps for every study included' under data/. No task produces this retrieval log; T004's outputs are only the snapshot JSON and cleaned CSV. The coverage table's 'Retrieval logs show only ClinicalTrials.gov and OSF' verification names an artifact no task creates.

Principle VII requires studies with ambiguous/unreported delivery format to be 'excluded from the primary subgroup analysis'. The cleaned-study schema permits delivery_format='unknown', but T007's delivery-format comparison has no step filtering out 'unknown' entries — a silent constitution violation.
US1 acceptance criterion requires output 'data/raw/excluded_studies.log'; no task produces this artifact. The exclusion audit trail acceptance criterion is dropped.

T007 adds 'Quantify blinding bias (blinded vs unblinded raters)' — a subgroup dimension in no FR, no plan task, and no schema field (no rater-blinding column exists in any contract). Orphan requirement with no extractable data source; either add it to spec+schema or remove.

FR-014 and US2 require suppressing meta-regression when N<10, but no task implements meta-regression at all, so the conditional logic has nothing to condition on. The coverage table masks this by mapping FR-014 only to funnel-plot/Egger suppression in T008/T009.
FR-009 (abstract-only text-extraction fallback) appears in plan Task 4 but is absent from T004's requirements list; the executable task list drops the requirement.

plan.md places source under src/ while tasks.md and the constitution use code/ (e.g., code/data/collector.py, pyproject.toml at projects/.../code/). Pick one layout and reconcile plan.md so an implementer following the plan doesn't violate the constitution's pinned-requirements location.

No task pins random seeds in code/ (Principle I) or records checksums for data/ files (Principle III). T010 verifies CI/local hash equality but nothing creates the checksummed baseline of raw/processed data.

Cleaned-study schema allows delivery_format='unknown' but effect-size format_tag enum omits it, so a study with unknown format cannot produce a schema-valid effect-size row even though Principle VII only mandates exclusion from subgroup analysis, not from effect-size calculation. Tasks T004/T005 inherit this contradiction.
